pages.text: It isn't over yet.$(br2)By using an Enchanted Command Block Book and some tainted dust on a fully-supported Withered Beacon, you can empower it for one final battle. This ultimate fight will test all your gear, abilities, and knowledge, and its reward would make any other goal you set easy.

There are many things to do before this battle. Look through the endgame category of this book for some ideas, and don't feel rushed to skip preparation! There's plenty of journey left, so enjoy it while it lasts.
